title: Modern Heart Granny Square Pattern
author: Lucy Kate Crochet
notes: Tr2tog is listed in the page's abbreviation key but not used in the pattern; omitted from the key here. Round 2 ends with (dc, ch 2, sl st) and is not joined in the usual way. Round 3: '2 tr into the space between the ch 3 and final dc of round 1' transcribed as 2tr@sp.
